_comment: What check-file-hygiene.mjs must not apply its house-style tier to here. The
CHECKER lives in claude-skills (tools/check-file-hygiene.mjs) so that all three
repositories can run it without a token; the RULE travels and these exemptions
stay home, because a checker three repositories run must not carry one
This file did not exist until 2026-09-14, and .github/workflows/test.yml said in
terms that it never would: 'This repository declares no .file-hygiene.json and
needs none: it has no generated corpus and no verbatim records, so the bare
rules are right.' That was true when it was written and scripts/fixtures/ made
it false the same day. The comment has been corrected rather than left to be
read as still describing the repository.
ONLY TIER 2 IS RELAXED. A byte-order mark and mixed line endings are still
findings in a captured file, and must be: those are the two faults that would
make a fixture differ from what the engine wrote in a way no diff shows.
notAuthored: verbatim engine output, captured off the map tree in buses-data and committed unchanged — the whole value of a captured fixture is that its bytes are the engine's, so adding a final newline here would make it our file rather than its. scripts/fixtures/README.md says where each one came from
